paite: Himahleh unaute aw, i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong paina leh amah tuak ding a i kikhopna ding thu ah;
heading: Puksanna

paite: Toupa ni atung khinta chihna kha in hiam aw, thu ziak in hiam aw, kou a kipan a laikhak ziak in hiam aw, na lungsim uh alin pahlouhna ding in leh na buailouhna ding un ka hon ngen uhi.
Kuamah in bangmah in hon khem kei uhen; puksanna tak ahong tun masak phot a, khelhna mipa, mangthang tapa ngei ahong kilat keileh huai ni tung lou ding ahi.
Ama'n Pathian kichi peuhmahte leh biak a om peuhmahte kalh in, amah leh amah kitawisang in Pathian tempul ah atu dia, Pathian in amah leh amah akibawl ding hi.
Na lak ua ka om lai in leng huai bang thu ka hon hilh zel chih na theigige kei ua hia?
Amah hun tuam a ahong kilattheihna ding in bang in kham ahia chih na thei uhi.
Dan lou a omna thuguk in tu in leng asem lellel ngal a, himahleh lakmang a a-om masiah tua akhampa'n huchibang in akham ding hi.
Huai lakmang ahih chiang in dan a talekpa ahong kilangta ding a, Toupa Jesu'n akam hatna in athat dia, ahong paina leh kilakna in ahihmang ding hi.
Huai dan a talekpa ahong paina Setan sepdan bang zel in, thilhihtheihna chiteng, chiamtehna chiteng, zuau thillamdang chiteng toh,
mangthang lelte ding in khemna gilou chiteng toh ahi ding; hotdam a a-omtheihna ding ua thutak itna apom louh ziak un.
Huaiziak in zuauthu agintakna ding un, Pathian in diklouhna nasep akiang uah ahon sawl ding hi;
thutak gingta lou a diktatlouhna a kipakzawte'n siam louh atan vek theihna ding un.

Unau Toupa ngaihtakte aw, Kha hihsiangthou leh thutak gingta a hotdam a om ding in atung a kipan Pathian in nou ahon tel ziak in na tungthu uah zaw Pathian kiang ah kipahthu gen zel ding him ka hi uhi.
heading: Dingkip Ding A Thuhilhna

paite: Huchibang ding in ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist thupina tang ding in ka tanchinhoih un nou ahon sam hi.
Huchi in unaute aw, dingkip unla, kam a ka thugen uleh laikhakte a nou ka hon sinsakte uh lenkip un.
Huchi in i Toupa Jesu Khrist mahmah leh Pathian i Pa, eite hon itpa leh hehpihna ziak a tangtawn a khamuanna leh lametna hoih hon pepa'n,
na lungtangte uh hihkhamuang in, thil hoih hih leh thugen chiteng ah hon hihkip hen.
